name: example-50k
description: A 50k evaluation geometry: 6% profit target, 4% end-of-day trailing drawdown that ratchets and locks at the starting balance, 2% intraday loss guard (a lockout, not a breach), 1 minimum trading day, no evaluation consistency rule. Replace every value with your own provider's published rules -- this ships as a WORKED EXAMPLE, not as anyone's current terms.
source: operator's own reading of their provider's published rules, verified at that date
